cohort: Pregnant women with Type 1 or 2 diabetes who attended specialized clinics from 2008 to 2020
finding: Missed antenatal diabetes appointments were associated with an increased likelihood of caesarean section and NICU admission in women with Type 1 diabetes and LGA infants in women with Type 2 diabetes, with above-target HbA1c levels potentially mediating these relationships.
mod_finding: Women with Type 1 diabetes who missed a prenatal appointment were more likely to have a cesarean section, and women with Type 2 diabetes who missed an appointment were more likely to have a large-for-gestational-age infant.
